name: PrimaryNav - Communities Derived
description: The Global community dropdown pinned open for capture — what replaced the old Communities menu after the November 2026 site feedback. It reads top to bottom in one column: a NEWSLETTER section holding a single Subscribe link to the site mailing-list sign-up (moved here from Content hub), then the WHATSAPP COMMUNITY section, both titled the same way and with no divider between them. Side by side, the one-link Newsletter section beside a long WhatsApp list read as a half-empty second column, so any menu made of titled sections now stacks. The WhatsApp section opens with Join the community, the hand-authored link an editor keeps in nav.json, and AI, Founders and Investors follow inside the same section, because they are groups within the WhatsApp community rather than its peers. Those three are generated from the communities collection at render time and sorted alphabetically, and they find the WhatsApp section by its label even though it is no longer first. The panel is pinned by the isolation route rather than a scenario interaction, because a hover or click does not survive the screenshot on this route and would capture the resting, closed menu.
